relationships.subject: C1-inhibitor
relationships.evidence_quote: Due to a lack of inhibition, bradykinin production is increased, which mediates vasodilatation, angiogenesis, and edema.

relationships.subject: Icatibant
relationships.evidence_quote: icatibant acts as a bradykinin receptor antagonist

relationships.subject: Ecallantide
relationships.evidence_quote: Ecallantide, a plasma kallikrein inhibitor, reduces bradykinin production

key_findings: Case of recurrent intestinal angioedema with normal C1-inhibitor that did not respond to icatibant.
